title: Metamorphic Testing of Quantum Software based on Stabilizer States
abstract: arXiv:2611.18838v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A major challenge in quantum computing is to systematically check if a quantum program implements its desired functionality. For classical programs, testing is widely used; each test case comprises a pair of sample input and expected output to be compared with the actual output. To increase the number of test cases, however, one has to solve the test-oracle problem: for each additional test input one has to know the correct output. Metamorphic testing tackles this problem by utilizing metamorphic relations between input and output domains to automatically derive new test cases from existing ones. However, adapting metamorphic testing to the quantum realm is not straightforward, since quantum states cannot be directly inspected. We propose a framework of quantum metamorphic testing (QMT) in which the metamorphic relations incorporate the measurement procedures required to assess quantum outputs. translated_title: 基于稳定子态的量子软件蜕变测试
translated_abstract: 量子计算中的一个重大挑战是如何系统地检验量子程序是否实现了其预期功能。对于经典程序，测试被广泛使用；每个测试用例由一对样本输入和预期输出组成，用于与实际输出进行比较。然而，要增加测试用例的数量，就必须解决测试预言机问题：对于每个新增的测试输入，都需要知道正确的输出。蜕变测试通过利用输入域与输出域之间的蜕变关系，从现有测试用例中自动推导出新的测试用例，从而解决了这一问题。然而，将蜕变测试应用于量子领域并非易事，因为量子态无法被直接检查。我们提出了一个量子蜕变测试（QMT）框架，其中的蜕变关系融入了评估量子输出所需的测量过程。我们将QMT框架应用于测试……
tldr: 提出了一种量子蜕变测试（QMT）框架，将评估量子输出所需的测量过程融入蜕变关系中，从而解决了因量子态无法直接检查而导致的测试预言机难题。
en_tdlr: A quantum metamorphic testing (QMT) framework is proposed that incorporates the measurement procedures needed to assess quantum outputs into metamorphic relations, addressing the test-oracle problem arising from the impossibility of directly inspecting quantum states.
